title: Sponsorships & Partnerships | CAPIT
description: Sponsor CAPIT's public well-plugging registry, partner on verified environmental data, or bring your organisation onto the Base network alongside us.
headline: Sponsorships & Partnerships
body: CAPIT publishes source-linked, time-stamped well-plugging records and mirrors verified physical closures 1:1 on the Base network. If your organisation funds plugging work, supplies public records, or wants its name attached to transparent environmental infrastructure reporting, there is a place for you here.

sections.heading: Sponsorships
sections.body: Sponsors support the ongoing cost of aggregating, verifying, and publishing public well-plugging records. Sponsorship placements appear alongside the national snapshot and state leaderboards.
bullets: Quarterly summary of records published during your sponsorship period

sections.heading: Partners
sections.body: Partners contribute data, tooling, or verification capacity. If you operate a state registry feed, a plugging service, or a measurement provider, we want to talk about wiring your records into the pipeline.
bullets: Direct flat-file or API record submission
Source attribution on every record you supply
Joint review of verification and publication rules

sections.heading: Clients
sections.body: Organisations that need auditable, source-linked evidence of well-plugging activity can build on the same registry that powers this site.
bullets: Revision history for corrected or withdrawn source records

sections.heading: What We Do Not Offer
sections.body: CAPIT publishes informational content and protocol materials. Nothing on this page is an offer to sell securities, an investment solicitation, or a guarantee of token value. Please review the methodology, disclosures, and contract details before interacting with any wallet or token feature.
